name: Local ASR/STT on MLX for Apple Silicon

mentions.name: Local ASR/STT on MLX for Apple Silicon
mentions.description: A local automatic speech recognition (ASR/STT) implementation running on MLX for Apple Silicon, built on Facebook's recently released omnilingual model. Model weights were ported from PyTorch to MLX using Claude.
mentions.source_excerpt: Local asr/stt on mlx for apple silicon based on Facebook omnilingual model that was just released.

evidence.value: Local asr/stt on mlx for apple silicon based on Facebook omnilingual model that was just released.
